SqlAuthenticationLogEntry.summary: Contains an immutable diagnostic produced by the Azure authentication provider.
SqlAuthenticationLogEntry.remarks: Entries are delivered through . Callbacks may run concurrently on authentication threads. They must execute synchronously, be thread-safe, return promptly, and not throw exceptions. Retaining an entry does not change its values. Messages marked must be handled as sensitive data and are never forwarded to SqlClient EventSource. Severity uses , matching SqlClient EventSource. is distinct from and is included when filtering by a severity threshold. Message wording and Source values are diagnostic text, not stable machine-readable contracts.

ctor.summary: Creates a stable snapshot before invoking an application's logging callback.
ctor.param: Whether the message requires sensitive-data handling.
The connection identifier, when correlation is available.

Level.summary: Gets the framework event severity of this diagnostic.

ContainsPii.summary: Gets whether the message may contain personal or organizational information.

Source.summary: Gets the diagnostic origin, such as MSAL, Azure-Identity, or SqlClient.

ConnectionId.summary: Gets the connection identifier, or null when the diagnostic cannot be correlated.
